# Reboil documentation

Reboil is a planned TypeScript state library for Expo, React Native, and browser React. It provides typed dot-path reads and writes, synchronous persistence, path-level subscriptions, and development logging without React Context or a Provider.

Status: specification stage; v1 is not released.

Recommended reading:
- /docs/overview
- /docs/getting-started/quick-start
- /docs/concepts/typed-paths
- /docs/concepts/persistence
- /docs/reference/api
- /docs/agents
